what:
**Round-6 user audit (2026-04-28):**

1. **Edit-this-page link broken.** Nextra's docsRepositoryBase points at `aide-memory/aide-memory` (the public repo, not the website repo). The website MDX files actually live in `aide-memory/aide-memory-web/pages/docs/`. Fix: theme.config.jsx `docsRepositoryBase: 'https://github.com/aide-memory/aide-memory-web/tree/main'`. Nextra appends the file path automatically, so it'll resolve to the right /pages/docs/foo.mdx.

2. **Hero layout bug — `aide-memory` is rendering on the same line as the badge.** Cause: `.hero-brand` and `.hero-badge` are both `display: inline-block` inside the centered `.hero-content` container. With `text-align: center` + two inline-block children, they sit on the same line. Fix: `.hero-brand { display: block; }` so it gets its own line. Verify visually after deploy.

3. **`.hero-team-note` should be bigger.** "Same text as 'Your agent remembers.' just smaller." So roughly the size of the title but lighter weight (or 70% of title size). Currently it's only 1rem (smaller than subtitle even). Bump to ~1.8-2rem with lighter weight (400-500), italic optional.

4. **Copy button still shifts.** The label width fix (min-width: 48px) helps but the SVG icon swap (rect→check) can also cause a width delta if the SVG implicit widths differ. Fix: explicitly set `width: 16px; height: 16px;` on both SVGs. Also lock the .copy-btn min-width higher (e.g. 90px) so any internal jitter doesn't propagate.

5. **Free card wording.** "More may be added in the future based on user feedback." → **"More features or tiers may be added based on user feedback."** User explicit phrasing.

6. **Step 2 "Work normally" too narrow.** Current: corrections + decisions + session-start context. Should also mention: when the agent reads or edits a relevant file, it gets prompted to recall existing memories. Storage isn't only triggered by corrections; user wants it broader/bigger-picture. Rewrite to cover: SessionStart context, PreToolUse recall on relevant files, capture on corrections AND decisions AND non-obvious findings, periodic Stop reflection, PreCompact save.

7. **"Next session, next teammate" → "Next session or next teammate"** in Step 3 title (and any other place that uses the comma).

8. **Remove "lessons learned" from subscribe form.** Currently: "Occasional updates on aide-memory: new editor adapters, releases, lessons learned. No spam." → drop "lessons learned": "Occasional updates on aide-memory: new editor adapters, releases. No spam."

9. **Buttondown + Vercel.** User asked if Vercel can run the mailing list. Vercel doesn't have a built-in mailing list product, but does have Resend integration for sending. Buttondown is the cleanest path today: free tier (100 subs), handles automated welcome emails automatically, embeddable form already wired. Keep Buttondown; explain that automated welcome email is already part of Buttondown's free product (no extra setup). If user wants a fully Vercel-native pipeline later, Vercel Postgres + Resend is the swap.

10. **Comprehensive doc-diff table format.** User wants the same format as the big numbered table from round-2 (items 1-98). Each row: file/section identifier, BEFORE literal text, AFTER literal text. Build that table for ALL user-doc pages over the round-1 → round-5 span, not just last-round changes. This is the "before + after for everything" deliverable that was promised after homepage approval.

**Process meta:**
- When CSS has two `display: inline-block` siblings inside `text-align: center`, they sit on the same line. If they should stack, one needs `display: block`. Default to `block` for hero-elements that should take their own row.
- Width-shifting widgets when state changes are paper-cuts to fix at first sight (already in #383). Round-6 caught a second instance (SVG width).
- "Same size" / "bigger" feedback on text means font-size, not just margin/weight.
why: Round-6 surfaces concrete UI bugs (hero layout broken, copy button still shifts, edit-this-page wrong target) plus phrasing tweaks (Free card, work-normally step, next-or-next phrasing, lessons-learned drop) plus a deliverable directive (comprehensive doc-diff table in the same format as the big round-2 table). Storing as priority:always so the durable rules (display: block for stacked hero elements, SVG explicit widths, broader work-normally framing, etc.) carry into every future doc-edit session.
